description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for git checkout and related commands, verifying behaviors like switching branches, reverting to previous states, and handling detached HEAD states.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes, used for setting up test scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands and checks for success.

methods.name: test_cmp_symbolic_HEAD_ref
methods.description: Compares the symbolic reference of HEAD with the expected branch name.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that the command it wraps fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output or references for test validation.
